scope: actual provider with synthetic feedback and controlled plan experiment; not App or executed research

synthetic_dialogue.GOAL: Evaluate policy evaluation frameworks for enterprise services and recommend a shortlist.
synthetic_dialogue.BEFORE: Reviewed public documentation only. Public Framework A ranked first; existing internal capabilities were not examined.
synthetic_dialogue.ADDITION: Also check the existing internal solutions and compare their capabilities with the public choices.
synthetic_dialogue.AFTER: The internal shared evaluation service already meets the requirements. Reusing that capability changes the preferred option; public Framework A is now a fallback.

limitations: Synthetic feedback and controlled plans; no real research or Desktop execution.
Lexical/citation checks and model-generated prose do not prove operational validity.
Native usage is not an invoice; cached-token counters can overlap native ledgers.
redactions: Private learning-home paths, transcript IDs, full progress payloads and live delivery receipts are omitted.
